title: Toronto, Niagara Falls & Thousand Islands 2–Day Trip
includes: Niagara Falls City Cruise (May-December) or Niagara Takes Flight 4D (April)
Complimentary courtesy pickup and dropoff from Montreal hotel within 5KM of departure point
Boat tour of The 1000 Islands Cruise (April 17th-October)
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Hotel accommodation prices are based on quad occupancy (4 people sharing a room)
cancellation:
If you cancel at least 6 full day(s) before the scheduled departure time, you will receive a full refund.
If you cancel between 2 and 6 day(s) before the scheduled departure time, you will receive a 50% refund.
If you cancel within 2 day(s) of the scheduled departure, you will receive a 0% refund.
blurb: Experience the Toronto & Niagara Falls 2-Day Adventure from Montreal! Start with a scenic Thousand Islands cruise, then explore the breathtaking Niagara Falls by Skylon tower and Niagara Falls city Cruise ( May -Dec), or experience the Niagara Takes Flight(4D) in winter. A fun, exciting, and family-friendly experience for all. Day 2 takes you to Toronto’s highlights, including the CN Tower and Ripley’s Aquarium, Canada’s largest. Finish your adventure and return to Montreal with unforgettable memories.
